payload.body:
ic to vc: ST0002/WP03, the which verb, LANDED on main as a fast-forward, 5139af2 (one commit), and cc signed its JSON's meaning at 90ca48e.
- RUN: Desk slot 01M7A0HZDCG6MXWT7T6AV2VP1F at 90ca48e. Its code is the landed code: git diff 90ca48e 5139af2 -- src tests Cargo.toml Cargo.lock README.md is empty, as main had moved by board commits alone. fmt clean; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast green, 73 unit (2 ignored, the keychain tests) and 38 CLI. Six one-line mutants red: the text in reverse order, at_cap spelt otherwise, times keeping their fraction, --use switching when the choice is active already, model names matched by case, and nothing eligible exiting 0.
- WHAT IT IS: cli.rs's which arm parses, reads every profile's report through the one function usage now shares with it, resolves --model, calls which::choose, switches through switch::to on --use, and renders through which::view, the one place the text and the JSON are written. Both render one Choice, in one order.
- THE TEXT, mine to shape, for your read. The choice's line comes first, eg "work: 48% left, resets in 1d23h, Fable 10% used, soonest reset with headroom". Then each other account has one line: "personal: 95% left, resets in 4d23h, eligible", "spare: 95% used, resets in 23h59, at the 95% cap", "broken: unknown, not authenticated; run ccusage login NAME". One departure from the work package's example, which says "27% left" for hello at 73%: left is the headroom, what is left before the cap, as cc defined it and the JSON gives it, because that is where the rule moves on, so hello reads 22% left under the 95% cap. At the cap, or with the headroom unknown, the line gives the percent used instead. Scoped windows and a session window are noted on their account's line and never ranked unless --model names the scoped one. With nothing eligible, the first line is "Nothing eligible: every account whose usage could be used is at the 95% cap; the soonest weekly reset is spare's, in 23h59.", stderr carries "ccusage: nothing eligible: ...", and it exits 1. --use adds use's own line, or "work is already the active account.".
- THE JSON: version 1 as agreed, typed in view.rs so the shape has one home. which_json_is_version_1_of_the_agreed_shape_in_the_texts_order fixes every field's name and order, the states, ranks and causes, the rounding and the form of every time. cc signed its meaning at 90ca48e.
- --model: matched regardless of case through one predicate the rule shares. A name no scoped window carries is refused before anything is printed, eg "no account's usage has a weekly limit for Fabel; the models seen: Fable".
- ACCEPTANCE: AT-03.1 to AT-03.4 are green on this run, so AC-03.1 to AC-03.4 compute satisfied. AT-02.1, AT-02.2, AT-02.4, AT-02.5 and AT-04.4 are re-cited to the lines WP03 moved. intent at lint ST0002 is clean, 18 of 18 (96e5ccf). wp done is yours after your read, as WP04's is.
- PLEASE READ: src/which/view.rs whole; cli.rs's which arm and its reports function; which.rs's model_named; the four which tests in tests/cli.rs.
- NEXT: WP05 (predict, whose arithmetic cc signs), then WP06 (the TUI's next marker, and the same in usage --all's text on whole fresh data), then WP08 and WP07.
